title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 59 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 59)

content.overview: Section 59 provides the statutory appeal from specified orders concerning refusal to refer parties to arbitration under section 54 and refusal to enforce a foreign award under section 57, with the statutory limitation on second appeals and preservation of Supreme Court appellate jurisdiction.
content.glance: Section 59 provides the statutory appeal from specified orders concerning refusal to refer parties to arbitration under section 54 and refusal to enforce a foreign award under section 57, with the statutory limitation on second appeals and preservation of Supreme Court appellate jurisdiction.
content.study:
Section 59 — Appealable orders

Section 59 provides the statutory appeal from specified orders concerning refusal to refer parties to arbitration under section 54 and refusal to enforce a foreign award under section 57, with the statutory limitation on second appeals and preservation of Supreme Court appellate jurisdiction.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
